skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the differences between traditional economic theory and behavioral economics, and analyze irrational economic behaviors.
Analyze and apply prospect theory and decision-making biases to improve decision-making processes.
Understand the impact of emotions on decision-making and apply emotional theories to decision-making processes.
Evaluate the differences between standard game theory and behavioral game theory, and apply practical strategies in economic decision-making.
Develop the ability to design models and methodologies to analyze decision-making issues for individuals and businesses.
Develop teamwork skills to effectively solve tasks and present persuasively to different audiences.
Plan and accumulate experience to enhance professional expertise.
Express and defend personal viewpoints based on objective and scientific approaches.
Identify and fulfill social responsibilities and professional ethics in making judgments and evaluations on professional issues.
